items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of exemption for boat jetty
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Nordmuster, Kreishaus, Marktstraße 1, 25813 Musterwik.
items.computation: Letter dated 2025-09-01 (Monday); assumed posted that day. Per the letter, posted decisions count as announced on the fourth day after posting: 2025-09-05 (Friday). Period of one month starts the next day (§187 BGB) and ends on the same-numbered day of the next month: 2025-10-05, which is a Sunday. Under §193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day: Monday 2025-10-06. Not a holiday in Schleswig-Holstein. The objection must reach the Kreis by then.

warnings: The actual posting date is unknown; the deadline assumes the letter was posted on its date, 2025-09-01. If it was posted later, the deadline moves later. To be safe, file by 2025-10-03.
The objection must be in writing, with a qualified electronic signature, or recorded in person at the Kreis; a plain email is not enough.
